The issuer shows adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio 1.27) and solid operating profitability (EBIT about 29.8% of revenue), with positive retained earnings supporting some financial resilience. However, leverage is heavy—total liabilities are about 4.2x equity and over 80% of assets are financed by liabilities—keeping credit quality near the low end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB-
